name: io.github.Pritom14/bucketlens
title: bucketlens
description: Let AI agents read the PDFs and spreadsheets in your S3 or R2 bucket: outlines, search, SQL.

environmentVariables.name: BUCKETLENS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Access key that can read the bucket and write under .bucketlens/

environmentVariables.name: BUCKETLENS_R2_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare account ID (for R2; sets the endpoint for you)

environmentVariables.name: BUCKETLENS_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: S3 endpoint URL (for AWS S3, MinIO or other S3-compatible storage)
